text: Now, let's walk through the deck.
Logistics costs India about eight percent of G D P, and only one point two percent of bills of lading are electronic.
Our fishbone traces the delays to six root causes, while the rails, like U-LIP and e-way bills, already exist.
So the solution puts one record at the centre, with four roles and six capabilities around it.
We built it in six phases, from discovery to verification, with the same tested loop for every feature.
Seven layers sit around a pure schedule engine, built with React, TypeScript, three J S and Zustand.
And every AI decision shows its evidence, its formula, and its confidence.
It's software only, with a twelve-week pilot on one lane, and a network flywheel to scale.
The control tower tracks the live corridor on a 3D globe, with each role's next action on the right.
The fleet view lists every shipment, with its milestones, status, and who holds the baton.
The document vault links fields across all three documents, with a SHA-256 chain of custody.
The marketplace re-ranks forwarder bids live as priorities change.
Financials shows demurrage exposure, and the escrow pipeline where each payout waits for its proof.
And sustainability tracks carbon per leg, with greener modes and a CBAM statement.
